product_brief: Cryptographic discovery tool for source code to assess quantum risk and plan post-quantum migration.
pqc_capability_description: Detects NIST-standardized PQC algorithms including ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205), and draft FN-DSA (FIPS 206). Also detects stateful hash-based signatures (XMSS, LMS per SP 800-208). Recognizes legacy names (Kyber, Dilithium, SPHINCS+). Identifies hybrid implementations (e.g., X25519+ML-KEM, ECDSA+ML-DSA).
crypto_primitives: RSA, ECDSA, DSA, DH, ECDH, Ed25519, X25519, AES, ChaCha20-Poly1305, DES, 3DES, RC4, Blowfish, SHA-2, SHA-3, SHAKE128/256, BLAKE2, BLAKE3, MD5, SHA-1, HMAC-SHA256/384/512, HMAC-SHA3, KMAC128/256, CMAC, GMAC, Poly1305, HKDF, PBKDF2, Argon2id, scrypt, bcrypt, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FN-DSA, XMSS, LMS
primary_platforms: Go 1.21+, Linux/macOS/Windows (implied by Go binary), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI
pqc_roadmap_details: v1.4 (Next): Smart remediation engine, Enhanced CBOM output, Git history scanning. v2.0 (Future): AWS/Azure/GCP resource scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code analysis.
signature_schemes: ECDSA, Ed25519, DSA, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FN-DSA, XMSS, LMS
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Yes. Scans source code, configs, and dependencies. Generates CBOM. Detects 90+ patterns. Context-aware confidence scoring.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Scans package manifests (package.json, go.mod, etc.) for crypto libraries. Generates CBOM.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Provides Migration Readiness Score. Maps to QRAMM framework. Offers migration guidance and remediation advice.
organizational_readiness: Maps findings to QRAMM Dimension 1: Cryptographic Visibility & Inventory.
